title: Console Tooling Standup - 2026-04-21
content:
Attendees: Ava, Liam, Priya, Diego, Maya

Sprint context (week of 2026-04-21): quick sync for console & tooling - focus areas: rollout manager UI, analytics ingestion fixes, rollout canary for model-switching feature, and dashboard polish for token-level cost breakdowns.

1) Rollout manager UI
- What we shipped: initial canary controls implemented on rollout-manager page (percent slider, schedule picker). Frontend PR merged yesterday (PR #378). Visual polish remaining: tooltip copy, disabled state styles for legacy flags.
- Blockers: Accessibility bug where slider is not keyboard-focusable (reported by Diego). Assigned to Liam, estimated fix by EOD 2026-04-22.
- Notes: We need a short UX note for legal on rollback semantics; Priya to draft and link to Confluence.
- Metrics to watch: number of canary toggles/day, avg time to rollback. Dashboard panels added to Grafana (linked above).

2) Canary rollout (model-switching)
- Status: Canary started at 10% traffic this morning for internal orgs. Initial latency and error rates look stable.
- Observed: small bump in 95p latency for requests > 2k tokens - likely related to kernel selection change on model variant B. SRE to investigate, alert created (alert CON-1178).
- Action: If 95p latency > +20% for 30m, pause canary. Maya to own pause/run decision for first 48h.

3) Analytics ingestion pipeline
- Problem: Missing event batches from client-side during heavy load window (2026-04-20 15:00-16:30). Cause traced to BigQuery load job timeouts and transient backpressure in ingestion lambda.
- Fixes in flight: increase BigQuery job timeouts + add retry with backoff in ingestion service. Diego has a patch in review (Jira CON-1123).
- Short-term mitigation: replay script ready, will backfill yesterday's missing events overnight. Priya to coordinate with data-platform for quota bump.

4) Dashboard / Console metrics
- Token-level cost breakdown: backend work merged; frontend needs mapping table for model->cost-per-token to render labels. Ava to add mapping and sample data for QA.
- UX ask: allow filtering by customer tier (free/pro/dedicated) - scope for next sprint.

5) Bugs & small tasks
- UI bug: modal overlaps header on Safari (reported by QA). Owner: Liam. ETA: 2026-04-23.
- Flaky e2e: rollout creation test flakes intermittently in CI (timeout). Diego to increase wait and add retries.
- Dashboard refresh: decrease default refresh from 30s to 15s for live rollouts view. Agreed but watch impact on metrics quotas.

6) Documentation / communication
- Priya will draft a short internal one-pager explaining new canary controls and rollback policy (target publish: 2026-04-23). Link to Confluence to be added to release notes.
- Customer-facing changelog: defer to release brief after 48h canary window.

7) Action items
- Liam: fix slider keyboard accessibility + Safari modal overlap. Due 2026-04-22 / 2026-04-23.
- Diego: finalize ingestion retry patch and submit PR; increase CI wait for e2e flakiness. Due 2026-04-22.
- Priya: draft UX/legal rollback note + internal one-pager; coordinate data-platform quota bump. Due 2026-04-23.
- Maya: monitor canary metrics, decide on pause/run windows, keep team updated in #console-rollouts Slack. Ongoing next 48h.
- Ava: add model->cost mapping sample data and wire to token-cost panel. Due 2026-04-22.

Decisions made
- Canary threshold: auto-pause if error-rate > 1% or 95p latency increases > 20% for 30m.
- Default canary size for internal orgs: 10% (will expand after 48h if stable).

Risks / open questions
- Does the kernel selection change need a separate rollout path? (SRE + serving runtime to advise). Action: schedule 30m sync with serving-runtime tomorrow.
- Legal wants clear rollback SLAs documented before prod expand - Priya to coordinate.

Notes to self / loose thoughts (informal)
- Consider adding a lightweight audit trail in rollout UI showing who changed percent and when (could reuse existing audit logs infra).
- Might make sense to ship a "preview" mode for canary to test UI without affecting traffic. Low priority.

Next sync: 2026-04-22 daily standup 10:30am PT. If anything urgent (canary pause triggers), ping #console-rollouts and call quick huddle.

Links & refs:
- Rollouts plan (Confluence): https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/CONSOLE/pages/23456/Console+Rollouts+Plan
- Jira: CON-1123 (ingestion retries), CON-1178 (canary alert)
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/378
- Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/console-rollouts/rollouts-overview

-- end of notes --
